text: 你举起火把照亮洞穴地上的尸体。那是肌肉发达得惊人的猿人。你仔细检查后确信，这必定就是北方传说所说的雪怪。你已经有了足以证明这一发现的实体证据。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 379
text: You raise a torch to illuminate the body on the floor of the cave. It is a man-ape of incredible musculature. Your examination satisfies you that this must be what northern legend calls a sasquatch. You have the physical evidence here to prove your discovery.
